bullets.text: PowerToys AI Clipboard Upgrade - **PowerToys** adds AI capabilities to its Advanced Paste feature for enhanced clipboard management.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features in **Windows 11** Insider Build enhance gaming and settings management.
Critical React Vulnerability Alert - **Microsoft** warns about CVE-2025-55182, a severe RCE vulnerability in React Server Components.
Leader in Generative AI Defense - **Microsoft** recognized as a leader in KuppingerCole's report for Generative AI security.
Introducing GPT-5.2 in Foundry - **Microsoft Foundry** launches GPT-5.2, setting a new standard for enterprise AI capabilities.
Enhancing Windows Terminal - **GitHub Copilot CLI** integration brings new functionalities to the Windows Terminal experience.
New Themes in Microsoft Store - **Microsoft** rolls out a new Themes department for personalized Windows experiences.
Azure Storage Innovations - **Microsoft Azure** enhances storage solutions to support AI workloads and data management.
Cybersecurity Imposter Risks - **Microsoft** details how fake employees can infiltrate organizations, posing significant security threats.
Building a Security-First Culture - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of cybersecurity in the era of AI and intelligent agents.
